messages.subject: Spatial Analysis in ggplot2
parts:
Hi,
I'm quite new in using R. I want to make spatial maps in ggplot2 but i fail to do so,
library(rgdal)
library(spdep)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggplot2)
setwd("C:/Users/PTI/Desktop/sam")
library(maptools)
data<-read.table("sidra.csv",header=TRUE,sep=",")
data  <- read.csv("sidra.csv", fileEncoding="utf8", stringsAsFactors=F)
data
require(rgdal)
shp <- readOGR(".", "Export_Output", stringsAsFactors=FALSE, encoding="UTF-8")
plot(shp, axes=TRUE, border="gray")
temp  <- merge(shp, data, by.x="Id", by.y="Id")
head(temp)

library (SpatialEpi)
Y<-temp$Observed
E<-temp$Expected
smr<-Y/E
mapvariable (Y , temp)
 

my question is that can i made this plot in ggplot2 also

any help will be appricated

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: Spatial Analysis in ggplot2
parts:
I'm not familiar with the SpatialEpi package; and if you're new to R
entirely, this may be a tough go. Perhaps start by learning ggplot's
basics, and then about plotting spatial data using ggplot (many web
references for both of these can be found). I'd also suggest checking
out the ggmaps package.

More generally, given that you have what looks like working code,
maybe consider whether it's necessary to re-do that in ggplot?

Ben
